facts.v: Split durable orchestration from GitOps deploy on Kubernetes.
Factory loop uses in-process durability; deploy uses GitOps sync status.
GitOps deploy path: sync DeploymentRequest CR and wait on status, not kubectl as durability layer.
Pod-step builds and tests in the factory loop.
In-process durable orchestration for the agentic software factory loop.
Agentic software factory: Temporal or Restate for loop durability, Tekton or Argo Workflows for pod steps, Argo CD or Flux for deploy.
Prefer Restate over Temporal when a lighter in-process durable runtime is enough.
Agents must not hold cluster-admin apply; GitOps owns cluster changes.
